en.headline: Transport Advisory Committee discusses Star Ferry fare increase application
en.dek: Members balanced the operator’s financial viability against public acceptability for proposed rises of about 30 per cent on the two franchised cross-harbour routes.
body: The Transport Advisory Committee on Thursday discussed the Star Ferry Company’s application to raise fares on its Central–Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai–Tsim Sha Tsui franchised routes.

Chairman Professor Wong Sze-chun said members had noted the company’s operational and financial performance and its measures to enhance service and revenue. In deliberating the application, the committee balanced the long-term viability of the ferry service with public acceptance of the proposed increases, which average around 30 per cent.

The committee will submit its recommendation to the government for consideration by the Chief Executive in Council. Members also noted the company’s interest in introducing a pet-friendly service, which could help boost non-fare revenue.

zh.headline: 交諮會討論天星小輪兩航線加價申請 將向政府提交建議
zh.dek: 委員已平衡渡輪服務長遠財務可行性與公眾對擬議約三成加幅的接受程度，稍後提交建議供行政會議考慮。
body: 交通諮詢委員會今日討論天星小輪就中環—尖沙嘴及灣仔—尖沙嘴兩條專營渡輪航線的加價申請。
主席黃仕進表示，委員備悉天星小輪的營運及財務表現，以及提升服務和收入的措施。商議時已平衡渡輪服務的長遠財務可行性，以及公眾對擬議票價加幅的接受程度和負擔能力。
交諮會稍後會向政府提交建議，供行政長官會同行政會議考慮。委員亦知悉公司有意引入寵物共乘服務，相信有助提升非票務收入。
